story.fullStory:
Tom Petty's "Runnin' Down A Dream" reached #23 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Runnin' Down a Dream" is a song co-written and recorded by Tom Petty.

It was released in July 1989 as the second single from his first solo album Full Moon Fever.

"Runnin' Down a Dream" achieved reasonable chart success, reaching number 23 both in Canada and on the US Billboard Hot 100 and the top of the Billboard Album Rock Tracks chart.

The song peaked at #23 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.
